text:
Kai: Heads up — ran into confusing runtime behavior with config overrides. Project has enable_new_routing: false, org override set to true, but console still shows project value in the flag list. App picks true at runtime. Expected a visible note about an active override. Anyone seen this?

Liz: Yep, seen it. Current precedence is org > project > route, but we don’t surface the source in the flag list UI. UX shows stale-looking value which is 👎. We should show an "Overridden by org" pill and link to audit.

Omar: Can we also add an explicit "effective_value" field to the runtime config API so callers don't need to infer? Something like:```json
GET /internal/config?flag=enable_new_routing
{
  "flag": "enable_new_routing",
  "effective": true,
  "source": "org:security-team",
  "applied_at": "2025-10-24T18:12:34Z"
}
```
That would make routing policies deterministic in the client.

Anya: Agreed on effective_value. Also concerned about scope/permission: org-level overrides are powerful. Suggest adding a toggle on the flag: "Allow overrides by org admins" (default true) and require 2FA + release notes for any org override. Also we need an audit alert if an override flips a canary flag.

Kai: Good call. On the runtime side I prefer the API return full {effective, source, local_value, override_reason} so the console can present both values and the diff. Minimal change to clients if we keep existing field names backward compatible.

Omar: Edge-case: rollout percentages. If project has 10% rollout and org overrides to 50%, do we treat that as a hard replace or merge? I vote replace — overrides should be authoritative. But we should surface a warning when the effective % > project % to avoid surprises.

Liz: UX tasks: add pill + hover tooltip, show source id + human name, link to audit log entry. Also add an inline banner in the flag detail page when effective != local. I’ll spin up a ticket.

Anya: Policy tasks: draft gating for org overrides (who can do it, require justification). I’ll loop in security and CS for impact on customers.

deploy-bot: audit: override_applied org_id=rdw-org-87 user=security-bot flag=enable_new_routing from=false to=true at=2025-10-24T18:12:34Z

Kai: Action items: Liz -> UX ticket, Omar -> runtime API PR for effective/source fields (backcompat), Anya -> policy doc + alerting rules. I’ll add a small flag in the console to surface overrides until the full UX is ready. :+1:

Liz: Sounds good. Keeping the console explicit will reduce "why is my routing different" p0s. :thumbsup:
